baselines.consensus_verification: Direct cryptographic commitment on Ethereum L1 (BLOBHASH / KZG)
baselines.permanence_model: Pruned by consensus nodes after retention window; requires external archivers
baselines.retrieval_guarantee: Consensus layer P2P gossip during window; public Beacon API (unstable) or dedicated archival nodes
baselines.typical_payer: Dataset Publisher (one-time fee during transaction broadcast)
baselines.citations: EIP-4844: Sharded Data Gas (Buterin et al., 2022); Ethereum Execution & Consensus Specs

baselines.consensus_verification: Merkle Patricia Trie transaction receipt root committed in block header
baselines.permanence_model: Retained indefinitely by archive and full nodes (subject to future EIP-4444 history pruning)
baselines.typical_payer: Dataset Publisher (one-time gas payment during submission)
baselines.citations: Ethereum Yellow Paper (Wood, 2014); EIP-7623 Increase Calldata Cost (Piet et al., 2024)

baselines.availability_period: Perpetual (Retained in state trie of every consensus node)
baselines.consensus_verification: Direct real-time contract execution readability and EVM consensus state root
baselines.permanence_model: Permanent state until explicitly modified or cleared via SLOAD/SSTORE
baselines.retrieval_guarantee: Direct synchronous contract read; instant query without network downloads
baselines.typical_payer: Dataset Publisher (20,000 gas per 32-byte slot allocation)
baselines.citations: Ethereum Yellow Paper (Wood, 2014); EIP-2200 Gas metering of SSTORE

baselines.availability_period: Pin-Dependent (Available only while at least one node hosts the CID)
baselines.consensus_verification: No native consensus verification; verifiable via multihash CID match
baselines.permanence_model: Volatile without dedicated pinning service or economic contract
baselines.retrieval_guarantee: Bitswap P2P routing / public IPFS HTTP gateways (subject to rate limiting)
baselines.typical_payer: Publisher or Community Pinner (Subscription to pinning service, e.g. Pinata/Web3.Storage)
baselines.measured_or_estimated: Estimated based on commercial pinning service pricing (2026 rates)
baselines.citations: IPFS - Content Addressed, Versioned, P2P File System (Benet, 2014)

baselines.availability_period: Contract-Dependent (typically 180 to 540 days per deal cycle)
baselines.consensus_verification: Cryptographic Proof of Replication (PoRep) and Proof of Spacetime (PoSt)
baselines.permanence_model: Active contract renewal required; automatic termination upon deal expiration
baselines.retrieval_guarantee: Storage provider retrieval contract or Lassie / Saturn CDN retrieval nodes
baselines.typical_payer: Storage Client (FIL tokens per sector deal duration + retrieval fees)
baselines.measured_or_estimated: Estimated based on Filecoin Network economic indices (2026)
baselines.citations: Filecoin: A Decentralized Storage Network (Protocol Labs, 2017)

baselines.availability_period: Intended Long-Term (~200 years theoretical storage endowment)
baselines.consensus_verification: Proof of Access (PoA / SPoRA) on independent blockweave
baselines.permanence_model: Protocol-enforced permanent retention funded by upfront fee endowment
baselines.retrieval_guarantee: Direct weave retrieval through gateway nodes (arweave.net)
baselines.typical_payer: Dataset Publisher (one-time upfront AR fee covering multi-decade storage)
baselines.measured_or_estimated: Estimated based on Arweave network fee calculator (2026)
baselines.citations: Arweave: A Protocol for Economically Sustainable Permanent Storage (Williams et al., 2019)
